outcome: perceived knowledge of functional habitual constipation (FC)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 933 adults over 18 years of age living in the Eastern Province of Saudi Arabia.
finding: The study found that parents in the local community have a good perceived knowledge of FC, with knowledge scores significantly higher in females than males, in participants aged 20-29 years compared to 30-39 years, and in those with three or more children compared to those with only one child.
